results.title: Uruguay FIFA World Cup 2026 Squad Announcement and Team Preview | tapmad
highlights:
Marcelo Bielsa has officially named his 26-man squad for the tournament in the United States, Mexico, and Canada. The group reflects Bielsa's philosophy, featuring energetic midfielders, aggressive defenders, and attackers capable of thriving in a high-tempo system.
[...]
Since taking charge of Uruguay, Marcelo Bielsa has implemented an aggressive and energetic style built around pressing, vertical transitions, and quick ball progression. Uruguay are expected to line up in either a 4-3-3 or a flexible 4-2-3-1 system depending on the opposition.
[...]
The midfield is the heartbeat of the team. Manuel Ugarte provides defensive security and ball-winning ability, while Rodrigo Bentancur offers composure in possession. Federico Valverde serves as the driving force, capable of carrying the ball forward, creating chances, and contributing defensively.
[...]
There is little doubt about who Uruguay's most influential player is entering the tournament.
[...]
Valverde has developed into one of the world's most complete midfielders at Real Madrid and is expected to be the leader of this squad throughout the competition.

highlights:
Saudi Arabia vs Uruguay lineups are yet to be confirmed for Group H Match 15 at the FIFA World Cup 2026. The Saudi Arabia national football team and Uruguay national football team meet on June 15, 2026, at Miami Stadium, with kickoff at 18:00 ET. This projected tracker covers the starting XI, formations, bench options, managers, and matchday lineup changes. This Saudi Arabia national football team vs Uruguay national football team lineups tracker stays projected until official match sheets arrive.

Saudi Arabia have announced a 30-player World Cup group under Georgios Donis, with Salem Al Dawsari, Saud Abdulhamid, Mohammed Kanno, Feras Al Buraikan, and Saleh Al Shehri among the main names. Uruguay’s final 26-man list remains yet to be confirmed, but Marcelo Bielsa’s camp picture includes Darwin Nunez, Ronald Araujo, Manuel Ugarte, Facundo Pellistri, Giorgian De Arrascaeta, and several expected senior arrivals.
